item.description:
Kento Alpha 0.9.13, build 2511

Planar tracker: multipass

  • A Multipass section on the PlanarTracker's Track tab. passes picks single, forward and back, or multipass.
  • Under vary, each toggle adds a pass that changes one thing: direction, tracker, reference (the frames under refs), motion model, channel or search.
  • score by rates each frame of each pass by its confidence, its agreement with the other passes, and its smoothness. combine takes the most consistent path, each frame from the best pass with switch cost for a change, or the best single pass. smooth the joins blends where the pass changes.
  • Track all passes tracks them; nothing is keyed until Accept. Use pass for range uses one pass from in to out, and Discard drops the run. A graph shows each pass and the combined track.
  • Running in the background is on the menu, dim: the passes run now, with their progress.

Tracker: the planar track row

  • The Tracker's planar track row now sits in Tracking, as the design has it: the PlanarTracker menu, then guide search, fill gaps and points on it as toggles.
  • With points on it on, Add makes a track that rides the plane. The Point on the plane button is gone.

Links

  • Edit > Link (Alt+L) puts a link to each selected node beside it. Like a clone, its settings are its source's, both ways, keys included.
  • Edit > Unlink (Shift+Alt+L) makes links nodes of their own. Edit > Copy As Links (Alt+Cmd+L) puts links on the clipboard to paste.
  • A .nk writes links as Nuke does, and Nuke opens them as links. A script's links open in Kento as links; a link whose source is missing opens as a node of its own, and the load report says so.

MatchGrade

  • mask works with Asobi's methods too: the curves and matrix fit reads where both pictures' alpha say so, the other methods each picture by its own.
  • Before fitting, Asobi's curves and matrix now finds where the source sits in the target's frame: fitted, filling the frame or stretched, then blown up and moved a little. The closest match is kept, and the line beside Analyze says where the source was placed.
  • Bars are left out of the target only, as Asobi now does, and the histogram match no longer fails on an empty side.

Playback

  • The held frames are no longer let go at every play and stop. Play, stop and play again now plays from what's held.
  • A frame much bigger than the Viewer shows it is held smaller, as sharp as the screen can show it, so more frames fit and they're ready sooner. hold big frames at screen size, in Settings > Preferences > Performance, turns it off.
  • The picture past the format (overscan, or a move off it) plays from the cache too, as does the Clipping warning and Absolute values.

Roto

  • A point added on a B-spline or X-spline (Cmd+Alt-click) goes where you click on the curve. It had been placed at the middle of the control polygon, which pulled the curve away.

Remote control

  • planar.multipass and node.clone (clone, declone, link and unlink) are new.

Kento Alpha 0.9.12, build 2501

MatchGrade: Asobi's grade match

  • A method menu under match task. Nuke's fit is the default and works as before.
  • curves and matrix (Asobi) is for Match Graded Source, where the target is the same picture graded. It fits a tone curve for each channel and a color matrix where the two frames show the same picture. Burned-in text, changed patches, letterbox bars (in either picture) and clipped highlights are left out. Where the picture shows nothing of a color, that color is left alone.
  • Reinhard, MKL and HM-MKL-HM are for Match Different Clip. They move the source's colors to the target's overall.
  • knots sets how many points each curve has. min likeness sets how alike the pictures must be to match at all. Another picture is refused, and one that differs in places gets a warning.
  • The fit works in the color config's color timing space (ACEScct in an ACES config), so it suits a scene-linear comp. A line beside Analyze gives the difference before and after, how much of the frame was used, or why the shot wasn't matched.
  • Not in Kento yet: mask for these methods, and writing their match to a .nk.

MatchGrade: Export .cube

  • Export .cube... saves the match as a .cube and names it in outfile.
  • With Asobi's methods it's their fitted cube. A line at the top of the file says which space it applies in.
  • With Nuke's fit it's the 3D LUT, or the CDL baked over 0 to 1 when transform is CDL.

Point tracks and the planar tracker

  • The PlanarTracker's point tracks row picks a Tracker of the comp whose tracks help the plane. start places the plane on every frame from them, constrain holds it close to them through blur or a bare surface, and recover carries it where its own match is lost.
  • The other way round, the Tracker's planar track, under When a track fails, picks a PlanarTracker. Each search starts where the plane carries the point, so moves faster than the search area stay found.
  • fill gaps from the plane fills a track's missed frames from the plane's motion, not from the other tracks.
  • Point on the plane adds a track at the plane's center that rides the plane on every frame it's tracked.

Playback

  • Skip frames to keep the rate, on the Timeline's playback chip and in Settings > Viewer > Playback. While playing, a frame that isn't ready when its turn comes is skipped, so the motion keeps its real speed. Off (the default), every frame is played, waiting for any that aren't ready.

Remote control

  • matchgrade.analyze and tracker.on_plane are new.

Kento Alpha 0.9.11, build 2490

Heal, Dust and Wire removal

  • Three repair tools of Kento's own in RotoPaint's row, after Clone and Reveal. Their settings are on the row's repair menu.
  • Heal paints a blemish out. Around the stroke, it fills from the picture round it with its texture, or smoothly. From an offset (Cmd-click a source, as for Clone), it takes the tone at the stroke's edge.
  • Dust takes out specks that are there on one frame and not the next. Each pixel is compared with the frames either side and replaced only where it differs from them by more than the threshold, by their median or the nearest clean frame. It works on shots where the camera holds still.
  • Wire removal paints along a wire or rig and fills it across from its edges. Filling from other frames or a clean plate is on the menu, dim.
  • A .nk writes each as a clone stroke; Nuke shows a plain clone where Kento shows the repair.

Clones

  • Edit > Clone (Alt+K) puts a clone of each selected node beside it, as in Nuke. A clone's settings are its original's: change one in either node and both change, keys included. Its input and place are its own.
  • Edit > Declone (Shift+Alt+K) makes clones nodes of their own again, keeping their settings.
  • A .nk writes clones as Nuke does, and Nuke opens them as clones. A script's clones now open in Kento as live clones, not copies.

Roto's Tracking tab

  • The picked shape's layer, or the selected shapes, tracked as one plane through the Roto's input with the planar tracker. The shapes above leave the track out where they pass in front. The motion is keyed into the layer's or shapes' transform, as Nuke keys a tracked layer, so the shapes follow the picture.
  • Analyze forward and back over in to out, the step buttons, the five motion toggles, tolerance, adapt to light, every pixel refines it, a confidence summary, and Export track to make a PlanarTracker of the track.
  • Not in Kento yet, shown dim: selected points, follow a track, points and mesh layers, edits kept on top, Stay linked.

Roto

  • invert and motion blur on each have a row and a key diamond in Selected shape, so they can change over time. Keyed, they switch halfway between an off key and an on key.
  • The curvature comb draws on X-spline shapes too.

Properties' size

  • The parts of Kento's own panels that stayed at 100% now follow Properties in Settings > Interface > Sizes. These include the Read's version chip, the header's file line, MultiMerge's layer list, and several panels' buttons, fields and labels.

Remote control

  • roto.track_plane and roto.export_track are new.
